Wananchi hao waliahidiwa kupewa ardhi mbadala ahadi ambayo Serikali imeendelea kuitimiza kwa kuchukua hatua zifuatazo:-

(i) Mwaka 1997 baadhi ya wananchi waligawiwa ardhi kwenye mashamba Na. 1, 5, 10 na 13 yaliyoko eneo la Oljoro yenye ukubwa wa ekari 6,051 ambayo yalikabidhiwa Halmashauri ya Wilaya Arumeru ili iwagawie wananchi husika.

(ii) Kutokana na udogo wa ardhi iliyotolewa ikilinganishwa na idadi ya wananchi ambao ardhi yao ilitwaliwa Oldonyosambu, Serikali imeendelea na jitihada za kupata ardhi sehemu nyingine ili kuwamilikisha wananchi hao. Kutokana na umuhimu ambao Serikali ya Chama cha Mapinduzi imeweka katika kutatua kero za wananchi, tarehe 20 Machi, 2012, Mheshimiwa Waziri Mkuu alimwagiza Mkuu wa Mkoa wa Arusha awapatie wananchi hao ardhi kwenye eneo lililokuwa linamilikiwa na Jeshi la Wananchi
katika eneo lililokuwa la Tanganyika Packers, Kata za Moshono na Mlangarini.

Hata hivyo, uhakiki wa eneo hilo ulionesha kuwa, ardhi iliyoko ni kidogo ikilinganishwa na idadi ya wananchi wa Kata za Mshono, Mlangarini na Oldonyosambu ambao wote wanahitaji ardhi kwa ajili ya kilimo na makazi. Hivyo, Serikali ilielekeza kuwa, uongozi wa Mkoa wa Arusha na Wilaya ya Arumeru watafute mashamba yasiyoendelezwa ili Serikali iyatwae na kuwamilikisha wananchi hao.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, napenda kulijulisha Bunge lako Tukufu kuwa, kazi ya uhakiki wa mashamba Wilayani Arumeru na hususan eneo la Oldonyosambu imekamilika na hivi sasa Mkoa unakamilisha maandalizi ya taarifa ambayo itawasilishwa Wizara ya Ardhi, Nyumba na Maendeleo ya Makazi, ili kibali cha Mheshimiwa Rais kiombwe kwa ajili ya kuyafutia miliki. Kwa kuwa suala la wananchi hawa limechukua muda mrefu, kupitia Bunge lako Tukufu natoa maelekezo kwa uongozi wa Mkoa wa Arusha, kuhakikisha kuwa taarifa ya uhakiki na mapendekezo ya utoaji mashamba hayo inakamilika ili kibali cha Mheshimiwa Rais kiombwe kabla ya mwisho wa mwaka 2013.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa niaba ya Serikali, nawashukuru sana wananchi wa Oldonyosambu, kwa uvumilivu wao na nawasihi waendelee kuwa na subira hadi taratibu za kuwapatia ardhi zitakapokamilika.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nashukuru. Pamoja na majibu mazuri ya Mheshimiwa Naibu

Waziri, nina swali moja dogo la nyongeza. Kwa kuwa uhakiki wa mashamba haya umekamilika, je, Serikali inajipanga vipi katika zoezi la ugawaji wa mashamba haya kuhakikisha yanatolewa bila upendeleo ili walengwa wakuu waweze kupata mashamba haya?
Majibu kwa kifupi sana Mheshimiwa Naibu Waziri Ardhi, Nyumba na Maendeleo ya Makazi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Serikali imejipanga kuhakikisha kwamba wananchi wanaostahili kupatiwa ardhi, wanapata ardhi hiyo kwa utaratibu ufuatao. Kwanza, tumeshafanya uhakiki na kupata idadi halisi ya wananchi ambao wanahitaji ardhi na orodha ya wananchi wale imewasilishwa na mapendekezo ya kutwaa mashamba hayo yatakapopelekwa kwa Mheshimiwa Rais, yatapelekwa pamoja na orodha ya wananchi wale ambao watanufaika.
Swali la mwisho kabisa kwa siku ya leo, Mjumbe wa Kamati ya Ardhi, Maliasili na Mazingira, Mheshimiwa Ester Bulaya.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ahsante kwa kuniona. Kumekuwa na tabia kwa baadhi ya wawekezaji wa ndani na nje, kutumia ardhi yetu kwenda kukopa benki na pindi mtikisiko wa uchumi unapokuwa mkubwa, wamekuwa wakishindwa kuwekeza na wakati wananchi wanahitaji ardhi hiyo na mwisho wake kuleta migogoro.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba nitoe mfano wa maeneo mawili. Kuna Kampuni ya Bioship ya Kilwa, ilichukua ardhi zaidi ya vijiji vinne kwa ajili ya kulima mibono, baada ya kukosa mikopo wameshindwa kuwekeza na matokeo yake wanafanya biashara haramu ya kuvuna mbao. Pili, kulikuwa na mashamba ya NAFCO maeneo ya Kigamboni, wakamuuzia mwekezaji Manji, zaidi ya heka mia mbili na hilo eneo lipo, limeshindwa kuwekezwa. Sasa tunaenda katika mkakati wa kilimo cha SAGCOT, nilitaka kujua Serikali imejipanga vipi kuhakikisha wawekezaji wanaopewa maeneo wana mitaji ya kutosha na kutumia maeneo hayo kwa uwekezaji ambao wamepanga?
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nakushukuru.
Majibu Mheshimiwa Naibu Waziri kifupi uwezavyo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, tumezingatia mifano ambayo Mheshimiwa Mbunge ametupa na napenda tu kulijulisha Bunge lako Tukufu kwamba Serikali imekwishabaini matatizo hayo ambayo wenzetu wanakuja na kutujulisha nia yao ya kuwekeza katika kilimo lakini baada ya kupewa ardhi, kikubwa wanachofanya ni kwenda kutumia ardhi ile kukopa. Wakishakopa, fedha zile haziendi sana kwenye kilimo, huenda kwingine na baadaye hutafuta visingizio vya kutaka kugawa ardhi ile na kuiuza.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kutokana na hali hiyo, tumechukua hatua ifuatayo:-

(i) Tumetoa maelekezo kwamba mwekezaji yeyote anapoleta maombi ya kupewa ardhi kwa ajili ya uwekezaji, Kamati ya Taifa ya Ugawaji Ardhi, kabla ya kufikiria ombi lile, ni sharti ijiridhishe kwamba mwekezaji huyo ameleta business plan pamoja na kuonyesha chanzo cha fedha zitakazotumika kwa ajili ya uwekezaji huo.

(ii) Tumemwelekeza Mkurugenzi wa Mipango Miji na Vijiji kwamba kuanzia sasa ardhi iliyotengwa kwa ajili ya kilimo, haitabadilishwa matumizi. Kwa sababu kumekuwa na tabia hiyo, watu wanachukua ardhi halafu kesho wanagawa viwanja ili wauze, wapate fedha harakaharaka waondoke. Kwa hivyo, kuanzia sasa, ardhi ya kilimo hatabadilishwa matumizi.
Nakushukuru sana Mheshimiwa Naibu Waziri.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, kabla hatujaenda kwenye matangazo mtaona kwamba majibu yalikuwa marefu na maswali yalikuwa marefu, kama ambavyo Mheshimiwa Spika mara kadhaa amesisitiza, naomba pande zote tujitahidi kurudi kwenye line.
Tangazo la Mheshimiwa Zitto Kabwe, Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Hesabu za Serikali (PAC), anaomba wajumbe wa Kamati hiyo wakutane leo mchana, ukumbi Pius Msekwa B, saa saba.
Mheshimiwa William Ngeleja, Makamu Mwenyekiti, Kamati ya Katiba, Sheria na Utawala, anaomba wajumbe wa Kamati hiyo wakutane leo mchana saa saba jengo la utawala, ukumbi 219.
Wabunge wote wa Chama cha Mapinduzi wanaombwa kukutana ukumbi wa Pius Msekwa saa saba kwa ajili ya kikao chao cha Chama.
Mheshimiwa Jenista Mhagama, Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Bunge ya Maendeleo ya Jamii, anaomba Wabunge wa Kamati hiyo kukutana ukumbi 227, jengo la utawala, ghorofa ya pili, leo saa saba mchana.
Waheshimiwa Wabunge, naomba nitambue uwepo wa Spika, Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda kwenye Kiti chake, akiwawakilisha wananchi wa Njombe Kusini, karibu sana.
Pia nimemwona Mheshimiwa Nassari, muda mrefu sana hakuwepo Bungeni, tunakukaribisha.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, kuhusiana na uchangiaji katika sheria zetu hizi tunazojadili safari hii, mtakumbuka kwamba wakati ule wa bajeti tulikuwa tunaomba nafasi kupitia vyama vyetu, sasa mabadiliko yale yalikuwa ni wakati wa bajeti peke yake. Wakati huu wa kutunga sheria, tunaendelea kama kawaida, uchangiaji ni dakika kumi na tano kama kawaida na unaomba kwenye Meza kama ilivyokuwa pale mwanzo. Kwa hiyo, naomba wale ambao
mna nia ya kuchangia muendelee kuwaletea Makatibu wetu Mezani kama kawaida.
Baada ya maelezo hayo, Katibu!
MWONGOZO WA SPIKA
Mwongozo wa Spika.
Naona watu watatu harakaharaka, tuanze na Esther halafu tutaendelea.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nakushukuru. Naomba Mwongozo wako kwa mujibu wa Kanuni ya 68(7) lakini nijielekeze kwenye Kanuni ya 46(1), sijui kama nitahitaji kuisoma kwa ajili ya muda niendelee?
Endelea.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, wakati nauliza maswali yangu ya nyongeza, swali langu la kwanza la nyongeza halikuweza kujibiwa ambapo nilitaka kujua, je, shauri limefunguliwa katika Mahakama ipi na ni shauri namba ngapi? Mheshimiwa Naibu Waziri wakati anajibu swali langu namba 24, hilo lilikuwa swali la nyongeza, hakunijibu kabisa kuhusu hicho kipengele. Nataka kupata Mwongozo wako, ni kwa nini Naibu Waziri hakuweza kujibu swali langu na nifanye nini kuweza kupata hilo jibu maana ni la msingi sana.

Naibu Spika, nimesimama kuomba Mwongozo wako chini ya Kanuni 68(7). Jana wakati Waziri wa Nchi, Ofisi ya Waziri (Sera, Uratibu na Bunge), alipokuwa akijibu maswali ya nyongeza ya swali la msingi la Mheshimiwa Catherine Magige, lililohusiana na biashara ya madawa ya kulevya, kwenye maelezo yake alisema iwapo atawataja wale waliotuhumiwa katika biashara hii ya madawa ya kulevya, ndani ya Bunge lako Tukufu hakuna atakayebaki.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, hii siyo tu kwamba kauli hii inalidhalilisha tu Bunge lako na kutoa taswira isiyo sahihi bali tutakosa mahali pa kuficha nyuso zetu tukitoka hapa hata sisi ambao hatujawahi kushuhudia au kuona madawa ya kulevya inavyofanana.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa hiyo, nimesimama kuomba Mwongozo wako kama Serikali au Waziri anaweza kuwataja Wabunge hao kwa majina au vinginevyo afute kauli yake ili heshima ya Bunge lako iweze kubaki mahali panapostahili.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nashukuru sana. Naomba Mwongozo wako kwa Kanuni ya 68(7) ikisomwa pamoja na Kanuni ya 64(1)(a)(f) na (g).

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, mapema leo asubuhi katika kipindi cha maswali na majibu, Mheshimiwa Mwigulu Nchemba alipokuwa anauliza swali la nyongeza, akatoa maeneo mbalimbali ambayo watu wamewahi kufariki na akatoa mfano wa Morogoro, Polisi walivyompiga risasi mtu

mmoja anayeitwa Juma kwenye mkutano. Akatoa mfano wa Ndago, mtu mmoja alifariki kwenye mkutano wa hadhara, kutokana na watu ambao walienda kufanya fujo. Mwisho akasema kwamba, kama sheria ingekuwa inafutwa, then Mheshimiwa Mbowe pamoja na Mheshimiwa Dkt. Wilbrod Slaa walikuwa wanapaswa wawe gerezani.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sasa kwa Kanuni ya 64(1)(a)(f) na (g), haya ni maneno ambayo siyo ya kweli, haya ni maneno ya kuchafua watu.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kimsingi kama haki inatakiwa itendeke; mnakumbuka kifo cha Msafiri Mbwambo, aliyekuwa Mwenyekiti wa CHADEMA Tawi la USA River, aliyechinjwa kwa chainsaw na waliomchinja wakabainika ni Wenyeviti wa Matawi ya CCM ambao walitoroka kwenye Mahakama ya Arusha wakiwa wamefungwa pingu na wakatoroka mpaka leo hawajulikani wako wapi kwa sababu wangetaja waliowatuma ambao wanatoka katika chama hicho.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa heshima kubwa, namwomba Mheshimiwa Mwigulu Nchemba afute kauli yake.
Umemlaumu mwenzako kwa kutuhumu na wewe umeenda kutuhumu. Mheshimiwa Haroub!

Spika, kwa ruhusa yako, naomba Mwongozo wako kupitia Kanuni ya 68(7) pia nikirejea Kanuni ya 46(1) ambayo inasema, Waziri aliyeulizwa swali atakuwa na wajibu wa kujibu swali hilo kwa ukamilifu kama lilivyoulizwa. Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, katika swali langu la msingi namba 15, kabla halijajibiwa niliomba lijibiwe kwa usahihi, lakini niliuliza maswali ya nyongeza mawili lakini swali langu la pili la nyongeza halikujibiwa kabisa. Swali hilo nilitaka kujua kama Serikali ina mpango gani wa kukusanya mapato katika Halmashauri zetu hasa za mijini, mapato ambayo yanatokana na kodi za maegesho ya magari na kodi nyingine ambazo sikuzitaja katika swali hilo lakini pia zinakusanywa kama kodi za kukusanya taka ngumu, ambazo zinakusanywa kwa kiasi kikubwa sana.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Bunge hili kama unavyojua limejidhatiti kusaidia Serikali kukusanya mapato, mapato haya yanakusanywa mengi lakini hayafiki Serikali. Mapato yanavuja na ushahidi unaonekana na hata katika takwimu alizoleta Mheshimiwa Waziri. Swali hili Mheshimiwa Waziri aliliacha, hakulijibu, naomba Mwongozo wako.
Kwa sababu ya muda, nitaruhusu moja tu lipate maelezo ya haraka kwa sasa. Mheshimiwa Waziri ya Nchi, Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu!
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, jana ni kweli nilijibu swali hilo lakini muuliza swali alikuwa anataka mimi niwataje,

yaani Serikali iwe inawataja watu wote wanaotuhumiwa na wanasema kwamba kuna orodha nyingi zimekabidhiwa kila mahali, kwa nini Serikali tuna kigugumizi cha kutaja orodha hiyo ya majina? Sasa mimi nikasema, kazi ya Serikali siyo kutangaza majina. Kazi ya Serikali ni kukamata, kupeleleza na kupeleka kwenye vyombo vya sheria. Nikatoa mfano, yako magazeti yameanza kutangaza na kama kuna mtu anaona kwamba amehujumiwa atakwenda Mahakamani. Hata hivyo, Serikali hii ambayo inaongozwa kwa misingi ya sheria, hatutakubali kutangaza orodha ambazo ni nyingi, nyingi sana zinaandikwa na watu mbalimbali na nyingi zinaandikwa hazina hata majina ya nani ametunga hiyo orodha, majina mengi yanaorodheshwa kila mara. Ndiyo maana nikatoa mfano; nikasema hizi orodha nyingi sana zinazoandikwa, hata sisi Wabunge humu ndani wanatuandika au wanatuorodhesha, humu ndani hatutapona.
Wataje.

Kwa msingi huohuo nimesema, hata awe nani ameandika katika orodha hizo zinazosambazwa hovyohovyo kwenye magazeti na sehemu nyingine, Serikali haitatangaza hata siku moja mpaka ifanye uchunguzi, ijiridhishe na ndipo hawa watu wanaweza kwenda kwenye vyombo vya sheria.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, awe Mbunge ameandikwa kwenye orodha yoyote, awe kiongozi wa namna gani, awe mwananchi wa kawaida akiandikwa kwenye orodha

yoyote na mtu yeyote, Serikali hatutakurupuka kutangaza. Narudia tena hatutakurupuka kutangaza kwa sababu siyo kazi yetu, kazi yetu sisi tumepewa madaraka na uwezo Kikatiba, kuchunguza na kufikisha kwenye vyombo vya sheria.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa hiyo, hayo ndiyo yalikuwa majibu yangu ya jana kwamba, sisi hatutakubali kutangaza orodha yoyote itakayoandikwa. Katika orodha hizo zinazosambazwa, mmesoma hata kwenye gazeti la Jamhuri la juzi, kuna majina ya Wabunge humo na majina ya wafanyabiashara. Kazi hiyo hatufanyi sisi, wafanye watu wengine, Serikali hatufanyi kazi hiyo ya kutangaza.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa hiyo, sikuwa nimekusudia kwamba, Wabunge ni wafanyabiashara wa madawa ya kulevya; ila nimekataa Serikali kujiingiza katika kitendo cha kushabikia mambo yasiyo ya ukweli. Serikali itafanya mambo ya uhakika na yaliyo ya kweli yataishia Mahakamani.
Sawasawa.
Nakushukuru, mengine haya nitayatolea maelezo mbele ya safari, Katibu!
HOJA ZA BUNGE
Azimio la Bunge la Kumpongeza Mheshimiwa Anne
Semamba Makinda (Mb), Spika wa Bunge la Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania kwa Kuchaguliwa kuwa Rais
wa Chama cha Mabunge ya Nchi Wanachama wa
Jumuiya ya Madola (Commonwealth Parliamentary
Association-CPA) Kanda ya Afrika
Naomba nimwite Mheshimiwa Mussa Azzan Zungu, Mheshimiwa Zungu ni Mwenyekiti wa Tawi la CPA kwa Bunge la Tanzania.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Azimio la Bunge la kumpongeza Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda (MB), Spika wa Bunge la Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, kwa kuchaguliwa kuwa Rais wa Chama cha Jumuiya ya Mabunge ya Nchi Wanachama wa Jumuiya ya Madola Afrika.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, tarehe 17 - 27 Julai, mwaka 2013, ulifanyika mkutano wa 44 wa Chama cha Mabunge ya Nchi ya Wanachama Jumuiya ya Madola Afrika, Commonwealth Parliamentary Association (CPA), uliofanyika Windhoek Namibia na Bunge letu liliwakilishwa na Wabunge wafuatao:-
Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda - Spika, Mheshimiwa Mussa A. Zungu-Mwenyekiti wa CPA Tawi la Tanzania, Mheshimiwa Beatrice M. Shellukindo – Makamu Mwenyekiti wa CPA, Kanda ya Afrika, Mheshimiwa Kabwe

Z. Zitto, Mwakilishi wa Tawi na Mjumbe wa Kamati ya Mipango ya Fedha wa CPA Kanda ya Afrika, Mheshimiwa Magale J. Shibuda, Mheshimiwa Dkt. Maua A. Daftari, Mheshimiwa Magdalena H. Sakaya na Mheshimiwa Mhonga S. Ruhwanya.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, pamoja na mambo mengine kataka Mkutano huo, ambao lengo lake kuu lilikuwa ni kujadili na kuona ni namna gani nchi wanachama wanaweza kutumia Umoja wao katika kutatua migogoro pamoja na kustawisha maendeleo ya kiuchumi Barani Afrika (utilizing our Commonwealth Partnership to promote conflict resolution and economic development in Africa). Kulikuwa na jukumu kubwa na zito kumchagua Rais wa Chama hiki atakayekuwa kiongozi wa nchi 19 na matawi 45 ya Afrika.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa kutambua uwezo na sifa za viongozi wa Tanzania, Tawi la CPA Tanzania lilipendekeza jina la Mheshimiwa Anne S. Makinda – Spika, kuwa mgombea wa nafasi hii kwa kuamini kuwa ni mwadilifu, mwenye uzoefu wa kutosha na mchapa kazi na hivyo kuwa na sifa stahiki za kugombea nafasi hii.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, jitihada mbalimbali zilizofanywa siku zote na Rais wetu wa Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, Mheshimiwa Jakaya Mrisho Kikwete, za kutangaza nchi yetu kimataifa, zilisaidia sana katika mchakato wa kumnadi mgombea wetu kwa wajumbe wa mkutano ambao ndio walikuwa wapiga kura katika uchaguzi huo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, katika uchaguzi huo, Mheshimiwa Anne S. Makinda alichaguliwa kwa kishindo kuwa Rais wa CPA kanda ya Afrika kwa muda wa mwaka mmoja, jambo ambalo limeiletea nchi yetu heshima na sifa kubwa sana kimataifa.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa kutambua jambo hili, natumia fursa hii kuliomba Bunge kama chombo cha uwakilishi wa wananchi kuridhia Azimio la kumpongeza Mheshimiwa Spika kwa kuchaguliwa kuwa Rais wa CPA Kanda ya Afrika kama ifuatavyo:-

KWA KUWA Bunge la Tanzania ni mwanachama wa Umoja wa Kibunge Jumuiya ya Madola, The Commonwealth Parliamentary Association’ kwa muda mrefu sasa na imekuwa ikishiriki kikamilifu shughuli za umoja huo na kutoa fursa sawa za uwakilishi kwa raia wake wote bila kujali jinsia, jambo ambalo limewezesha wanawake wengi kushika nyadhifa mbalimbali za uongozi Kitaifa na Kimataifa.
NA KWA KUWA Rais wa Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, ameonesha jitahada mbalimbali za kuitangaza nchi yetu Kimataifa, jambo ambalo limewezesha fursa nyingi kupatikana.
NA KWA KUWA katika mkutano wa 44 wa CPA –Afrika uliofanyika Windhoek, Namibia, Mheshimiwa Anne S. Makinda - Spika wa Bunge la Jamhuri ya Muungano wa
Tanzania, alichaguliwa kuwa Rais wa CPA, Kanda ya Afrika.

NA KWA KUWA, Mheshimiwa Spika ana uzoefu wa kutosha katika medani za siasa na uongozi kwa zaidi ya miaka 37 kwa kushika nyazifa mbalimbali kama vile kuwa Naibu Spika, Spika wa Bunge la Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Bunge ya Ardhi, Maliasili na Mazingira, Mwenyekiti wa Bunge, Waziri katika Wizara mbalimbali, Makamu Mwenyekiti wa SADC-PF na kadhalika, jambo ambalo linaondoa shaka ya aina yoyote juu ya uwezo wake.

HIVYO BASI Bunge hili katika Mkutano wake wa Kumi na Mbili linaazimia kumpongeza Mheshimiwa Spika wa Bunge la Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda, kwa kuchaguliwa kuwa Rais wa Chama cha Mabunge ya Nchi za Wanachama Jumuiya za Madola, Commonwealth Parliamentary Association, Kanda ya Afrika na kwamba linamtakia kila kheri Mheshimiwa Spika katika kutekeleza majukumu yake haya mapya na mazito, kwa kuongoza nchi 19 na Matawi 45 katika Bara zima la Afrika.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba kutoa hoja.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naafiki.
Ahsante sana Mheshimiwa Zungu. Hoja imetolewa na imeungwa mkono na Wabunge wote, sijawahi kuona Hoja imeungwa mkono kwa kishindo namna hii, hongereni sana.
(Hapa Waheshimiwa Wabunge walishangilia
kwa kupiga makofi na vigelegele)

Sasa kwa niaba yetu sisi sote, niwaombe Wabunge watatu wazungumze kwa kifupi kwa dakika zisizopungua kumi na tano kila mmoja. Tunaanza na Mheshimiwa Anna Abdallah, Mheshimiwa Rashid Mohammed na Mheshimiwa Profesa Mark Mwandosya.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ahsante sana kwa kunipa nafasi hii ya kwanza na mimi nichangie katika hoja hii aliyoitoa Mheshimiwa Mussa Azzan Zungu, Azimio la kumpongeza Spika wetu wa Bunge, Mheshimiwa Anne S. Makinda.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, awali ya yote na mimi nachukua nafasi hii kuunga mkono Azimio hili. Vilevile niwashukuru Waheshimiwa Wabunge wote kwa kuunga mkono Azimio hili japo kila mtu hatapata nafasi ya kusema na akasikika hapa, lakini tu kwamba wote tumesimama kuliunga mkono, ni jambo la heshima sana kwa Spika wetu na Bunge letu Tukufu la Tanzania.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba kabisa kuunga mkono Azimio hili la kumpongeza Mheshimiwa Spika wetu
wa Bunge, Mheshimiwa Anne S. Makinda kwa sababu zifuatazo:-

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwanza kabisa, Mheshimiwa Makinda ni Mtanzania mwenzetu siyo kwamba hapajatokea kuwa na Wenyeviti wengine wa CPA Afrika, wapo lakini kwa leo ni Mtanzania. Kwa hiyo, sisi Wabunge wa Bunge la Jamhuri hii, tunayo kila sababu ya kufurahia na Watanzania wenzetu wana kila sababu ya kufurahia uteuzi huu wa Mheshimiwa Anne S. Makinda. Kubwa ni kwamba, yeye ni Spika wetu. Wakati kinara wa Bunge anapopata heshima ya namna hii katika Afrika basi kwa kweli anabeba heshima ya Watanzania wote na kwa kweli amebeba heshima ya sisi Wabunge.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naomba niseme heshima hii amepata yeye lakini ni kwa niaba yetu sisi. Ameipata kwa sababu ya uwezo wake wa kuongoza na kwamba amekuwa kiongozi siyo tu kwa kuchupia humu ndani ya Bunge, la hasha! Amekuwa ndani ya Bunge hili na hiki ni kipindi cha nane. Kwa hiyo, anaelewa mambo ya Bunge yanavyokwenda na ni mtu ambaye anaweza kutabiri mambo kwamba hapa linalokuja ni hili. Kwa hiyo, tunampongeza sana na nina hakika atatumia ujuzi wake huo katika kuongoza CPA Afrika.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kubwa zaidi ni heshima kwa wanawake wa Tanzania na wanawake wa Afrika nzima. Sisi wanawake tumekuwa siku zote tukieleza na kutabiri na kusisitiza juu ya kumpa fursa sawa mwanamke kama anao uwezo wa kuongoza. Sasa hakuna shaka yoyote kwamba,

mwana mama huyu, Spika wa Bunge letu ni kiongozi mwenye uwezo. Kwa hiyo, sisi wanawake tuna kila sababu ya kufurahia uteuzi huu na kumwombea kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ampe zaidi ya hapo. Hata kama atagombea CPA ya Kimataifa, tunamshauri akagombee tu, tuna hakika tutashinda.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, lakini siyo hilo tu, kwani hata akigombea Urais wa Jamhuri kutakuwa na tatizo gani?
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa hiyo, sisi tunampongeza sana, apokee salamu kutoka kwa akina mama wenzake ambao ni asilimia 51% ya Watanzania.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, ahsante sana.
Ahsante sana Mheshimiwa Mama Anna Abdallah. Sasa ni zamu ya Mheshimiwa Hamad Rashid Mohamed.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwanza, nikishukuru na mimi kwa kunipa nafasi hii ya pili ya kuunga mkono Azimio la kumpongeza Mheshimiwa Anne S. Makinda, Spika wetu wa Bunge la Jamhuri la Muungano wa Tanzania, kwa nafasi hii muhimu, kwake na kwa Taifa. Zaidi nisemi kwamba, tangu nimfahamu Mheshimiwa Makinda, mwaka 1977, tulipokuwa pamoja kwenye Public Accounts Committee, kwa umahiri wake na
namna anavyojituma katika kazi, haya ndiyo matokeo ya mtu anayejituma katika kazi.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, Mheshimiwa Makinda ana rasilimali kubwa sana ya uelewa wa taasisi mbalimbali za ndani na nje ya nchi, lakini kubwa alilolifanya katika kipindi chake hiki ni kuhakikisha vilevile hawi mchoyo katika kuwa- promote na wengine. Ndiyo maana ukaona katika Bunge letu hili amewajaalia na kuwasaidia Wabunge wengine kupata nafasi mbalimbali katika taasisi mbalimbali za uongozi bila kujali vyama, itikadi, rangi, kabila au udini. Mimi naomba tumpongeze kwa hilo na tunajifunza kwa hilo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, vilevile tumpongeze, kwa Tanzania ni bahati, katika Maspika wote niliokaa nao ni mara ya kwanza kuwa na Spika mwanamke. Alikuwa na challenge kubwa kuchukua nafasi ya Uspika, lakini amedhihirisha uwezo wake na ndiyo maana leo CPA wamemfanya kuwa president wa Afrika CPA.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kwa hiyo, kwangu namwomba kwanza Mwenyezi Mungu amwongezee afya, aendelee kutoa mchango kwa Taifa letu, aendelee kuwashauri na vijana vilevile waige nyayo zake, maana bila ya kuwa na watu ambao wana uzoefu, uzoefu wa uadilifu, uzoefu wa kutenda kazi, vijana hawawezi kupata dira nzuri ya kujifunza. Kwa hiyo, naomba aendelee na awe mvumilivu na hilo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, lakini tatu, taasisi hii ya CPA, imekuwa ikionekana kama ni chombo cha wenzetu, Waingereza zaidi, sasa tunapata fursa ya kuonekana kwamba ni taasisi inayomilikiwa na nchi za Jumuiya ya Madola ambazo idadi kubwa ni nchi za Kiafrika na Kiasia. Mimi nafikiri hiyo ni kazi muhimu inatakiwa ifanyike sasa hivi ili ionekane inatoa yale matunda ambayo tunayategemea.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, mwisho, Mheshimiwa Anne Makinda amepata challenge kubwa sana kuwa Spika wetu hapa. Wakati mmoja nilikuwa nasema, inahitaji pande zote mbili ili Jaji aweze kufanya kazi yake vizuri. Ili Jaji afanye kazi vizuri, Mawakili wa upande wa utetezi na washtaki lazima wafanye kazi nzuri vilevile, ili yeye aweze kutoa haki. Tumemsadia na wenzetu nje wameona kazi aliyoifanya hapa na ndiyo maana amepata nafasi hii. Naomba tuendelee kumsaidia kufanya kazi zake hapa ndani ya Bunge, tumsaidie katika kazi hii mpya aliyoipata ili nchi yetu izidi kung’ara na heshima yetu tuliyokuwa nayo Tanzania katika nyanja za Kimataifa irudie kama ilivyokuwa zamani na zaidi ya hapo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, baada ya kusema hayo, naomba nami niunge mkono Azimio hili alilowasilisha Mheshimiwa Zungu, lakini nimpongeze sana Mheshimiwa Anne na ninamwomba Mwenyezi Mungu amsaidie katika kazi hii. Ahsante sana.
Mheshimiwa Hamad Rashid, ahsate sana. Sasa namwomba Mheshimiwa Profesa Mark J. Mwandosya azungumze.
MAALUM: Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nianze kwa kuunga mkono Azimio hili.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, watu wana sifa nyingi lakini wengine wana sifa zilizozidi, ndivyo Mwenyezi Mungu alivyotuumba na ndivyo ambavyo wengine wanapata uongozi. Sasa kwa maana ya Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda, mimi naweza kuziweka hizo sifa katika vigezo kumi na nitavisema harakaharaka.
(i) Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda ni mtu anayejiamini.
(ii) Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda ni mtenda haki.
(iii) Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda ni mchapa kazi.
(iv) Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda ni mzoefu.
(v) Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda ni msikivu.
(vi) Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda ni mbunifu.
(vii) Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda ni mwelewa.
(viii) Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda mvumilivu.
(ix) Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda ni mnyenyekevu.
(x) Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda ana msimamo.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, si wengi na hatutakuwa wengi au hawatakuwa wengi ambao wameanza kuwa Wabunge, wamekuwa Mawaziri, wamekuwa Wakuu wa Mikoa, wamekuwa Naibu Spika mpaka kuwa Spika, haiwezekani, ni wachache sana. Hizi ni sifa ambazo zote ni za Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda ambazo amemjalia Mwenyezi Mungu.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, hajajitokeza hivihivi, amejengwa, alilelewa, amepikwa, mpaka amefikia hapo. Nani aliyefanya kazi hiyo, lazima tuwape sifa.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sifa hiyo ni ya wachache na nitawataja. Kwanza, familia yake, wananchi wa Njombe, Watanzania kwa ujumla wetu.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, vilevile, Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda uongozi wake umeanzia alipokuwa Shule ya Msingi inayoitwa Wemba. Kaenda sekondari

inayoitwa Kilakala, nadhani alianzia Masasi halafu akaenda Kilakala. Vilevile, kasoma Chuo cha Maendeleo na Uongozi Mzumbe, ndiyo walioweka msingi wa Chuo Kikuu cha sasa cha Mzumbe. Sasa mimi nasema Wemba, Masasi, Kilakala, Mzumbe, tunawashukuru kwa kumjenga.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sasa tunakwenda mwaka 2015…
Yes!
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kuna mwenzangu mmoja hapa alikuwa ananong’ona, sitamtaja jina, akamwambia mwenzake akasema, unasikia, ni tishio mwaka 2015. (Vicheko/Makofi)

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, sasa mimi nitalizungumzia la mwaka 2015 kutokana na mwongozo na vilevile mfano aliouweka. Unajua unaweza ukatenda mambo Kitaifa yakafanyika Kisheria au Kikatiba lakini mengine ni watu kuiga mfano wa watu. Sasa kwa upande wa Mheshimiwa Anne Makinda, yeye kuwa pale, kuwa mfano, kwa sifa nilizozitaja, ninaamini, wasichana wengi nchi hii watataka kuwa viongozi. Naamini, wanawake wengi nchi hii watataka kuwa Wabunge kwamba bila Katiba mpya, mimi naamini kwamba, mwaka 2015 wanawake watakuwa asilimia 55 na zaidi katika Bunge la Jamuhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, naunga mkono hoja, ahsante.
Mheshimiwa Profesa Mark Mwandosya, ahsante sana kwa maneno yako ya busara sana.
Sasa naomba nimwite mtoa hoja, Mheshimiwa Mussa Z. Azzan, Mwenyekiti wa Tawi la CPA Tanzania, aje ahitimishe hoja aliyoitoa.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, kabla sijakamilisha hoja yangu hii, kwanza naomba nimtaje Mheshimiwa Nassir Abdallah, Mbunge wa Korogwe na yeye alihudhuria kikao hiki na alikuwa mpiga debe mkubwa sana wa Mheshimiwa Spika. Nimwombe radhi tu kwa kutolitaja jina lake mwanzo kutokana na hitilafu za uchapishaji.

Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, mimi nawashukuru Wabunge wote waliounga mkono hoja hii, kwa ujumla wote, lakini vilevile niwashukuru Wabunge watatu mahiri ambao wamesema maneno ya busara, ya hekima na ya kumpa nguvu. Kazi hii si ndogo, ni kazi kubwa sana na kipindi hiki licha ya kuwa yeye ni Spika wa Bunge letu, bado atakuwa na majukumu ya Afrika, majukumu ya migogoro, ya uchumi, ya jinsia na yeye ni Mheshimiwa Spika, yuko mstari wa mbele sana ku-balance gender, nampongeza sana Mheshimiwa Spika.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, mimi namwombea kwa Mwenyezi Mungu ampe afya njema, umri mrefu, aweze
kutimiza majukumu yake kwa ujasiri na kwa busara kubwa sana.
Mheshimiwa Naibu Spika, nakushuru sana.

Mheshimiwa Mussa Z. Azzan, ahsante sana kwa kuhitimisha hoja yako na kabla sijawahoji Waheshimiwa Wabunge na mimi niseme kidogo tu. Imekuwa si kawaida sana kwa nchi yetu kuwatambua na kuwathamini na kuwaenzi viongozi ambao wamechangia sehemu kubwa sana ya maisha yao katika maendeleo ya watu wetu wa Tanzania. Kwa maoni yangu, hili ni moja ya upungufu mkubwa sana katika nchi yetu ya Tanzania, kutotambua mchango wa mtu ambacho kimekuwepo Tanzania ni lawama kwa viongozi mazuri yao hakuna anayeyaona hata mmoja. Hata mimi Jimboni kwangu nilikuwa najiuliza, sasa ni Mbunge kipindi cha tatu, ni mambo mengi sana yamefanyika ndani ya Jimbo langu, kwa kusukuma na mimi nikiwa na mchango mkubwa pia, hakuna jengo la darasa, wala zahanati, wala choo cha shule ambacho kimeandikwa kwamba jengo hili limewekwa Jiwe la Msingi wala kufunguliwa na Job Ndugai katika Wilaya ya Kongwa, hakuna.
Wanakuja wenzangu wa kila aina wanaweka majina yao lakini mimi hakuna hata moja. Kwa hiyo, siku nikitoka hakuna kumbukumbu hata moja, natumaini hata Wabunge wenzangu wengi ni hivyohivyo.
Kwa hiyo, tuna tatizo hilo katika nchi yetu kutotambua juhudi na michango ya watu, jambo ambalo ndilo
lingesaidia sana kuwapa moyo katika kufanya mambo makubwa zaidi. Sisi tunachokumbuka ni kuwalaumu tu watu.

Kwa hiyo, kipekee jambo hili la Azimio hili lililoletwa mbele yetu limenikumbusha mbali na mimi nikiwa mwanafunzi wa Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda, kwa sababu nilipofika tu hapa Bungeni niliingia katika Kamati ya Ardhi na Mazingira kwa miaka mitano, akawa ni Mwenyekiti wangu wa Kamati. Miaka mitano iliyofuata nimekuwa Mwenyekiti wa Bunge, yeye akiwa Naibu Spika alikuwa kiongozi wangu. Miaka mitano hii, yeye amepanda amekuwa Spika, bado niko chini yake kama Naibu wake. Kwa hiyo, nimejifunza mambo mengi sana yanayohusu masuala ya Bunge kupitia kwake na yote yaliyoelezwa hapa ni kweli tupu, yaliyoelezwa na Wabunge wenzetu ambao ni mahiri kabisa, wazoefu na tunaowategemea.

Kwa hiyo, kwa niaba ya Wabunge wote, tukutakie maisha marefu Mheshimiwa Anne Makinda, tukutakie utendaji bora na kwa kweli sisi wenzako tuko na wewe kwa pamoja kuhakikisha kwamba nafasi hii ya Rais wa Chama cha Jumuiya ya Mabunge ya Nchi za Afrika utaisimamia vizuri na tutakuwa pamoja nawe katika kuandaa mkutano mkubwa utakaofanyika Arusha mwakani hapa Tanzania kwa ajili ya Mabunge yote ya Afrika.

Kwa hatua hiyo basi, naomba sasa Waheshimiwa Wabunge niwahoji kuhusu Azimio hili la kumpongeza Mheshimiwa Anne Semamba Makinda, Spika wa Bunge letu la Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, kuchaguliwa kuwa
Rais wa Chama cha Jumuiya ya Mabunge ya Nchi Wanachama wa Jumuiya ya Madola Afrika.
(Azimio la Bunge la Kumpongeza Mheshimiwa Anne
Semamba Makinda, Spika wa Bunge laJamhuri ya
Muungano wa Tanzania, lilipitishwa na Bunge)
Nawashukuruni sana, Katibu!

A BILL
for
An Act to provide for the establishment of the National Irrigation
Commission; to provide for the development, operation and
maintenance of irrigation and drainage systems; to provide for
effective implementation the National Irrigation Policy, the National
Irrigation Development Strategy and to provide for other related
matters.
Enacted by the Parliament of the United Republic of Tanzania.
PART I
PRELIMINARY PROVISIONS
Short title and 1. This Act may be cited as the National Irrigation Commenceme
Act, 2013 and shall come into operation on such date nt
as the Minister may by notice in the Gazette appoint. Interpretation 2. In this Act unless the context otherwise
requires-
„authorized officer” means an officer acting for and
on behalf of the Commission, Local Government
Authority or the Management Committee of
Irrigators’ Organisation for the purposes of
implementation of this Act;
„canal” means an open channel carrying water
including situations passing through tunnel
enroute;
„channel” means any ditch, channel, aqueduct,
trench, conduit, tunnel, sluice, or fluming;
„Commission” means the National Irrigation
Commission a established under section 3;
„conduit” means a pipe or line of pipes of any
material or a series of culverts joined together for
conveyance of water for irrigation or drainage
purposes;
„Director General” means the Chief Executive Officer
of the Commission appointed under section 8; „distribution system” includes-
(a) all main canals or conduits, branch canals
or conduits, distribution canals or conduits or
minor canals constructed, maintained and
operated for the supply and distribution of
water for irrigation;
(b) all works, structures and appliances
connected with the distribution of water for
irrigation; and
(c) all field channels, farm channels and other
related channels and structures under a sluice
or turn out;
„drainage” means the practice of causing water to
be removed from the surface or subsoil of land
by natural or artificial means for betterment of
agriculture or other purposes; „drainage system” means a series of structures and
other allied infrastructure including the main,
secondary, tertiary and field drainage canals or
conduits necessary for the removal of excess
water and salts from an irrigation scheme in order
to allow effective agricultural operations and to
prevent water logging;
„drainage water” means water which is removed from
land by means of drainage works or by natural
drainage means;
„drainage works” includes the construction and
maintenance of drainage canals and channels
including sub-oil drain pipes, culverts, banks,
water gates, sluices and other similar works for
drainage purposes;
„Fund” means Irrigation Development Fund as
established under section 53 of this Act; „field channel” means irrigation system channel used
to convey irrigation water from tertiary canal into
the fields;
„headworks” means the engineering works
constructed at the point of abstraction of
irrigation water such as structures on a river
stream, pumping system or works at a dam or
water reservoir;
„Integrated Water Resources Management” means
an approach in water resources management
and development which holistically considers all
users of the resource upstream and downstream
of the system including the ecology; „irrigable” as applied to land means land of such
situation and quality as to be capable of being
irrigated from the works or proposed works of an
undertaking;
„irrigation” means the application of a specific
amount of water at a particular location in order
to meet the requirements of a crop growing at
that location in amounts that are appropriate to
the crop’s stage of growth, it can also involve the
application of water in amounts necessary to
bring soil to the desired moisture level prior to
crop planting;
„irrigation activities” means operation and
maintenance of the irrigation system in an
irrigation scheme for the purpose of crop
production;
„irrigation area” means an area irrigated or capable
of being irrigated either by gravitational flow or
by lift irrigation or by any other method so
declared by the Minister under the provisions of
section 17 of this Act;
„irrigation efficiency” means a ratio between the
amount of water effectively used for crop growth
to the amount diverted from the source; Cap.366 „irrigation Inspector” means an officer appointed
under section 14 of this Act to work as inspector;
„irrigation potential” means a total area which is
technically feasible, economically and financially
profitable, socially viable and environmentally
acceptable that is irrigated or capable of being
irrigated on the basis of water availability, land
availability and suitability;
„irrigation project” means an undertaking to
rehabilitate, upgrade, improve or develop an
irrigation and drainage system within a specified
time frame;
„irrigation scheme” means an area where crops are
grown under irrigation through any method
including flood recession; gravity or pump fed
canal systems supplying either surface or
groundwater; water harvesting and pressurized
systems such as drip and sprinkler;
„irrigation season” means that period of time
determined by the Irrigators’ Management
Committee during which irrigation water shall be
made available to an irrigation area”;
„irrigation service” means all activities aimed at
enhancing sustainability of an irrigation scheme
including but not limited to studies, planning,
research, designing, construction, operation and
maintenance of irrigation scheme and capacity
building programme;
„irrigation service fees” means fees payable and
collected in terms of section 40 of this Act for the
purposes of meeting costs of development,
operational and maintenance of irrigation works; „irrigation system” means a series of structures and
other allied infrastructure including the
headworks, water conveyance and distribution
systems, farm infrastructure, machinery and
equipment, necessary to provide the supply of
water for irrigation to a parcel of land; „irrigation water” means water which is put on to or
retained on land in an irrigation area by means
of irrigation works and includes water reaching
such land as rainfall;
„irrigation works or irrigation and drainage
infrastructure” means physical infrastructure
developed or installed in an irrigation system for
the purpose of facilitating availability of irrigation
water from a water source for crop production
covering abstraction structures, conveyance
structures, distribution structures, drainage
structures and on-farm service roads and
include-
(a) all canals, field channels, dam and tanks,
tube wells and filter point wells which are
intended or which may be used for the supply,
collection, storage or retention of water for
agricultural purposes;
(b) all works, embankments, structures, supply
and escape channels connected with such
canals, channels, dams or tanks and spouts
installed to supply water;
(c) all water courses which are supplied with
water from such canals, channels, dam, tanks
or spouts;
(d) all drainage works associated with irrigation
systems, that is to say, canals, channels,
escape channels from a canal or channel,
dam or tanks, weirs, embankments, sluices,
groynes, field channels, and other works for
the protection or benefit of agricultural lands
or for the reclamation of such other lands;
(e) all works intended for preventing or
regulating the entry of salt water into
agricultural lands;
(f) all works in an irrigation scheme occupied by
irrigators for the purpose of facilitating irrigated
agriculture such as canals, channels, reservoirs
or tanks and all buildings, machinery, fences,
gates and other erections on such lands; and
any other work which the Commission may,
by notification, declared to be an irrigation
work;
„irrigator” means an individual, company, or
organization which undertakes irrigation
operation in a particular scheme; „irigators’ organization” means group of farmers
formed and registered under this Act or any
other written law and approved by the
Commission pursuant to section 30 of this Act to
accommodate the joint interests and activities of
all the farmers on an irrigation scheme primarily
for ensuring increased crop production and
productivity through optimal management of
irrigation water and the operation and
maintenance of their scheme; „land or plot holder” means the owner, or any other
person in lawful possession of land in the irrigable
area of any irrigation scheme recorded as such
in the records of the Commission and includes a
lease or tenant and cultivator or other person in
actual possession, management or control of
any irrigable land;
„large scale irrigation scheme” means an irrigation
scheme with a command area greater than two
thousand hectares;
„lift irrigation work” means an irrigation work by which
water is supplied for agricultural purposes with
the aid of a pump set or other mechanical
devices;
„local government authority” means a local
government authority as defined in the Local
Government (District Authorities) Act and term
„Local Government Authorities” shall be
construed accordingly;
„medium scale irrigation scheme” means irrigation
scheme with a command area between five
hundred and two thousand hectares; „member” means a member of the Commission; „Minister” means the Minister responsible for irrigation; „minor irrigation work” includes any irrigation work
facilitating irrigation or useful for the drainage or
protection of an irrigable area of not more than
fifteen hectares but shall not include a lift
irrigation work;
„prescribe” means prescribed by Regulations or Rules
made under this Act;
Cap. 97 „Regional Secretariat” means the Regional
Secretariat established under the Regional
Administration Act;
Caps. 113 and „right of occupancy” has the meaning ascribed to it 114
under the Land Act and Village Land Act;
„shared functions” means a joint function undertaken
or to be undertaken by all stakeholders as may
be agreed upon including research, training,
extension services, inputs supply, crop
development and promotion, irrigation and
drainage infrastructure development;
„smallholder farmer” means a farmer engaged in
irrigation farming on a small holding of
agricultural land which is up to five hectares and
which is worked by only himself or with members
of his family;
„small scale irrigation scheme” means an irrigation
scheme with a command area up to five
hundred hectares;
„stakeholders” means a person or an organisation
involved in the irrigation sector including central
government, local government authorities,
Commission, development partners, cooperative
societies, producers, dealers of irrigation
equipment, input suppliers, research and
extension service providers and all persons with
vested interest in irrigation development;
„water course” means a river, stream, springs,
channel, lake and includes any tributary or
branch of any river, stream, springs or channel;
„water management” means all deliberative human
activities designed to optimize the availability
and utilization of water for agricultural purposes; Cap. 331 „water resource” has the meaning ascribed to it
under the Water Resources Management Act;
„water user” includes any individual or body corporate
or a society or an institution or organization using
water for any purpose from an irrigation system; Cap. 331 „water use permit” shall have the same meaning as
ascribed to it under the Water Resources
Management Act.

DECLARATION OF IRRIGATION AREA AND LAND CLASSIFICATION Declaratio 17.-(1) The Minister responsible for land may, after n of consultation with the Minister and by Order published in irrigation the Gazette, declare any area specified in the order to area be an irrigation area for the purposes of this Act.
(2) A declaration made under sub section (1),
shall define the boundaries of such area and may

method.
(3) Where it is proposed to constitute an irrigation
area under sub-section(1), the Commission shall
forward to the Minister a report with respect to the
proposed areas which shall contain or be
accompanied by the following particulars, namely-
(a) map or plan showing the boundaries and
the extent of the lands proposed to be
comprised in the area;
(b) a description setting forth the scheme and
purpose of the proposed irrigation works;
(c) a general plan, prepared on a scale
approved by the Minister, showing the nature
and extent of the proposed irrigation works;
(d) report on the Environmental and Social
Impact Assessment;
(e) an estimate of the total cost of the irrigation
works if to be constructed by the Commission
and of the annual charges necessary for the
maintenance and management of the
(f) an estimate of the annual revenue expected
to be derived from the proposed works; (g) an estimate of the quantity of water that is
proposed to be made available for use for
irrigation purposes in the area, after making
allowance for present and probable future
requirements for all or any other purposes; and
a statement on the sources from which it is
proposed to obtain it, specifying, where
deemed necessary, the quantity and quality of
water proposed to be taken from each of such
sources and the seasons at which it is to be
taken;
(h) statement of the existing water sources
within or outside of the area, over or from
which it is intended that the Commission should
exercise any control or draw any part of its
supply, and the nature or extent of such
control, and for what purpose such control is
necessary;
(i) an estimate of the approximate value of the
existing irrigation works, if any, within the area
which it is proposed that the Commission
should take over from any existing authority or
person;
(j) a statement of the quantity of irrigable land
that may be beneficially irrigated, and of the
character and description and value of such
land in its then state, including all existing
improvements;
(k) information in respect to the advantages
which are likely to accrue generally from the
establishment of the irrigation schemes in the
said irrigated area; and (l) any other information as may be prescribed in
the Regulations.
(4) The Minister may, at any time and upon
advice of the Commission, by order published in the
Gazette-
(a) combine two or more irrigation areas into
one area;
(b) divide an irrigation area into two or more
areas;
(c) alter the boundaries of an irrigation area by
including in an area part of another area and
excluding it from the latter;
(d) include in an irrigation area an outlying area
of the scheme;
(e) abolish any irrigation area; or
(f) adjust any financial or other matters in his
opinion has an advantage or is beneficial for
the irrigation development in the country.
(5) Where any declaration referred to in sub-
section (1), affects the existing land rights, the holder of
such land shall be entitled to compensation in
accordance with relevant land law or as may be
agreed upon.

OBJECTS AND REASONS

This Bill proposes for the enactment of the National Irrigation Act, 2013 with a view to ironing out challenges encountered in the irrigation sector. These challenges include the absence of a legal framework to protect and promote irrigation land; desertion and sabotage of irrigation works; inefficient of the current institutional framework which failed to keep paces with the rapid growth of irrigation activities; and lack of knowledge and awareness on the part of individuals that led to the poor performance in the management of irrigation works. In addition to that, the proposed Act seeks to establish the National Irrigation Commission, provide for the development, operation and maintenance of irrigation and drainage systems and for other related matters.
The Bill is divided into Ten Parts.
Part I of the Bill provides for preliminary matters including the name of the proposed Act as well as the definitions of words and phrases invariably used throughout the Bill.

In Part II, the Bill provides for the establishment of the National Irrigation Commission for purposes of coordinating, promoting and supervising the irrigations sector. This Part further provides for the composition of the Commission, committees of the Commission, powers of the Commission, appointment of the Director-General of the Commission and powers of the Commission to employ or appoint staff of the Commission. Other salient provisions of this Part include clause 10 that proposes for the establishment of zonal irrigation offices, district irrigation departments as well as the appointment of irrigation inspectors.

Part III of the Bill proposes for enactment of provisions relating to the declaration of irrigation areas and classification of irrigation land. In this Part, the Minister responsible for Agriculture is empowered to declare any specified area to be an irrigation area. This power is only exercisable upon consultations with the Minister responsible for Lands; Minister responsible for Water and the Minister responsible for local government authorities. Other salient provisions in this Part include clause 17 that authorizes the acquisition by the President, of land for purposes of irrigation, and clause 18 that deals with the classification of land for irrigation purposes.

In Part IV, the Bill proposes to make provisions for the construction of irrigation works. Salient features in this Part include clause 19 that specifies persons and entities who may undertake such construction as well as the procedures for obtaining permit to construct irrigation works; Clause 22 that provides for compensation for damages suffered by any person as a consequent of such

construction of irrigation works; and Clause 23 that empowers the Commission to entrust the construction of irrigation works to a local government authority, irrigators’ organization or any other body corporate.

In Part V, the Bill proposes to make provisions relating to irrigation schemes and irrigators. In this regard, the provisions relating to categorization of irrigation schemes and the categorization and approval of irrigators are well set out.

Part VI of the Bill deals with the management of irrigation schemes. In this Part, it is proposed that irrigation schemes be managed by the Commission, local government authorities, public or private entities and individual farmers or irrigators’ organizations. It is further proposed in this Part to make provisions for the establishment of irrigators’ organizations, functions of irrigators’ organizations, sources of funds of irrigators’ organizations, allocation of irrigation plots, protection of irrigation land, obligation of land owners in respect of works affecting safety of irrigation works, control of navigation and unplanned canal crossings, inter basin water transfer for irrigation and monitoring and evaluation of performance of irrigation schemes.

Part VII provides for environmental and health protection. It is proposed in this Part to make provisions covering environmental protection, promotion of irrigation research and the establishment of the National Irrigation Research Centre.

Part VIII of the Bill proposes for the financial provisions. The salient provisions in this Part include Clause 52 that proposes for the establishment of the Irrigation Development Fund for purposes of

ensuring development and sustainability of the irrigation sector; Clause 55 that provides for the management of the Fund; and Clause 60 that empowers the Commission to borrow and invest funds of the Commission as the Commission thinks fit for the betterment of irrigation sector.

Part IX proposes for offences and penalties for persons who contravene the proposed Act. The proposed offences under this Part include damaging irrigation systems or irrigation works; preventing the construction of irrigation works; obstructing any public officer in the lawful exercise of his powers under the proposed Act; and interfering or altering the flow of water in any irrigation work.

Part X provides for general provisions. This Part contains provisions that impose upon members and employees of the Commission or committee, a duty of secrecy in the discharge of their duties or performance of their functions under the proposed Act. It further provides for stakeholders meetings, powers of Ministers to require information, as well as the powers of the Minister to make rules and regulations.

MUSWADA
wa
Sheria inayoweka masharti kwa ajili ya Kuanzisha Tume ya Taifa ya
Umwagiliaji, Maendeleo, uendeshaji na utunzaji wa Mifumo ya
Umwagiliaji, kwa ajili ya utekelezaji wa Sera ya Taifa ya
Umwagiliaji, Mkakati wa Maendeleo ya Umwagiliaji, na kwa
ajili ya mambo mengine yanayohusu maudhui ya Sheria hii.
SEHEMU YA KWANZA
MAMBO YA AWALI
Jina 1. Sheria hii itaitwa Sheria ya Taifa ya Umwagiliaji ya
Mwaka 2013, na itaanza kutumika katika tarehe
itakayotangazwa na Waziri kupitia Tangazo la Serikali. Tafsiri 2. Katika Sheria hii isipokuwa kama mazingira
yatahitaji vinginevyo:
„afisa mwenye mamlaka” maana yake ni afisa
aliyeruhusiwa na Tume, Mamlaka ya Serikali za
Mitaa na Kamati Tendaji ya Vyama vya
Wamwagiliaji kwa madhumuni ya utekelezaji wa
Sheria hii;
„ada za huduma za umwagiliaji” maana yake ni ada
zinazolipwa au kukusanywa kwa mujibu wa kifungu
cha 40 cha Sheria hii kwa lengo la kukidhi gharama
za uendelezaji, uendeshaji na utunzaji wa
miundombinu ya umwagiliaji;
„bomba” maana yake ni bomba au mkondo uliojengwa
na kufunikwa ikijumuisha makalavati kwa kusafirishia
maji ya umwagiliaji au maji ya matupio;
„eneo linaloweza kumwagiliwa” maana yake ni ardhi
yenye ubora na inayoweza kumwagiliwa kutokana
na miundombinu iliyopo au inayopendekezwa
kutekelezwa;
„eneo la umwagiliaji” maana yake ni eneo
linalomwagiliwa au eneo linaloweza kumwagiliwa
kwa kutumia maji yanayotiririka kwa nguvu ya
mvutano wa ardhi au kwa kusukumwa na pampu
au kwa nyenzo nyingine kama itakavyotangazwa
na Waziri kwa mujibu wa kifungu cha 17;
„eneo linalofaa kwa umwagiliaji” maana yake ni eneo
linalofaa kitaalam, kiuchumi, kijamii na kimazingira
kwa kilimo cha umwagiliaji kwa kuzingatia uwepo
wa ardhi inayofaa kwa kilimo, upatikanaji wa maji
na hali ya kukubalika kiuchumi na kijamii; Sura ya 113 na „haki ya umiliki wa ardhi” ina maana kwam ilivyotafsiriwa 114
kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Ardhi na Sheria ya Ardhi ya
Vijiji;
‘‘hati ya haki ya kutumia maji” maana yake ni kama
ilivyotafsiriwa kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Usimamizi
wa Rasilimali ya Maji;
„halmashauri ya Wilaya” maana yake ni Mamlaka ya
Serikali za Mitaa kwa mujibu wa Sheria za Serikali za
Mitaa;
„huduma za umwagiliaji” maana yake ni shughuli au kazi
zote zinazolenga kuboresha uendelevu wa skimu ya
umwagiliaji zikijumuisha upembuzi yakinifu, utafiti,
usanifu, ujenzi, uendeshaji na utunzaji wa skimu ya
umwagiliaji na programu za kujenga uwezo wa
wamwagiliaji;
„kazi za matupio” maana yake kazi za ujenzi na utunzaji
wa mifereji ya maji ya matupio na miundombinu
inayoambatana nayo kwa lengo la kuondoa maji
yasiyohitajika;
„kazi za umwagiliaji” maana yake ni kazi za kuendesha
na kutunza mifumo ya umwagiliaji ndani ya skimu ya
umwagiliaji ili kuwezesha uzalishaji wa mazao;
„kazi za umwagiliaji au miundombinu ya umwagiliaji na
maji ya matupio” maana yake ni miundombinu
iliyojengwa au kuendelezwa katika mfumo wa
umwagiliaji kwa lengo la kuwezesha upatikanaji wa
maji kutoka katika chanzo kwa ajili ya uzalishaji wa
mazao na inajumuisha miundombinu ya
kuchapushia maji, ya kusafirisha na kusambaza maji
kwenda mashambani, ya kuondoa maji
yasiyohitajika na barabara za shambani ambazo
zinajumuisha-
(i) mifereji ya aina yote, mabwawa, visima na
miundombinu yote ya kukinga na kuhifadhi
maji kwa ajili ya kilimo;
(ii) kazi zote, tuta au kingo, miundombinu
mbalimbali ya kusafirisha maji kwenda
kwenye mabwawa ya kuhifadhi maji;
(iii) mifereji yote ya kusafirisha maji kutoka
kwenye mabwawa;
(iv) miundombinu yote ya kuondolea maji
yasiyohitajika au maji ya matupio katika
mfumo wa umwagiliaji ikiwemo mifereji, na
miundombinu ya kuzuia mafuriko ya
maeneo ya mashamba;
(v) miundombinu yote ya kuzuia maji ya
chumvichumvi kutapakaa katika
mashamba;
(vi) miundombinu yote katika skimu ya
umwagiliaji inayotumiwa na wamwagiliaji
au kazi zote kama zitakavyoainishwa na
Tume kama kazi za umwagiliaji; „kikundi cha umwagiliaji” maana yake ni kikundi cha
wakulima kilichoundwa na kusajiliwa kwa mujibu wa
Sheria hii au sheria nyingine na kuidhinishwa na
Tume kwa mujibu wa kifungu cha 30 kwa lengo la
kutekeleza kazi zenye manufaa kwa wakulima wote
katika skimu ya umwagiliaji ili kuhakikisha ongezeko
la tija katika uzalishaji wa mazao kutokana na
usimamizi wa maji ya umwagiliaji, uendeshaji na
utunzaji katika skimu zao;
„kibali cha matumizi ya maji” maana yake ni kibali cha
matumizi ya maji kama ilivyoanishwa kwenye Sheria Sura 331
ya Usimamizi wa Rasilimali ya Maji;
„Mkaguzi wa Umwagiliaji” maana yake ni afisa
aliyeteuliwa kwa mujibu wa kifungu cha 14 kufanya
kazi ya ukaguzi;
„Mkurugenzi Mkuu” maana yake ni Mtendaji Mkuu wa
Tume kama atakavyoteuliwa kwa mujibu wa
kifungu cha 8;
„mabanio” maana yake ni maumbo yaliyojengwa
kihandisi katika maeneo ya kuchepushia maji
kutoka kwenye vyanzo kwa ajili ya umwagiliaji
yakijumuisha maumbo katika mkondo wa maji,
pampu za kusukuma maji kutoka mtoni au
bwawani;
„matupio” maana yake hatua ya kuondoa maji ya ziada
au matupio kutoka shambani kwa lengo la kuweka
mazingira ya ustawi wa mazao ya kilimo;
„maji ya matupio” maana yake ni maji yanayoondolewa
shambani kwa kutumia mfumo wa maji ya matupio;
„maji ya umwagiliaji” maana yake ni maji yanayoingizwa
shambani kumwagilia eneo hilo la shamba kwa
kutumia miundombinu ya umwagiliaji na inajuisha
maji yatokanayo na mvua;
„majukumu ya pamoja” maana yake ni majukumu ya
pamoja yanayofanywa au yatakayofanywa na
wadau kama watakavyokubaliana yakijuisha utafiti,
mafunzo, huduma za ugani, usambazaji wa
pembejeo, maendeleo ya mazao na uhamasishaji,
umwagiliaji na uendelelezaji wa miundombinu ya
maji ya matupio;
„mfumo wa maji ya matupio” maana yake ni mlolongo
wa maumbo au miundombinu mingine ikijuisha
mifereji mikuu, ya kati, midogo na ya shambani au
mabomba mahsusi kwa kuondoa maji yasiyohitajika
na/au yenye chumvichumvi kutoka katika skimu ya
umwagiliaji ili kuwezesha shughuli za kilimo kufanyika
vizuri na kuzuia kutuama kwa maji shambani; „mfumo wa usambazaji” unajumuisha-
(a) mifereji mikuu na mtandao wa mifereji
iliyojengwa kwa ajili ya kusafirisha na kusambaza
maji ya umwagiliaji shambani;
(b) maumbo na miundombinu ya umwagiliaji
iliyojengwa kuunganisha mtandao wa
kusambaza maji ya kumwagilia;
(c) mtandao wa mifereji midogo na miundombinu
yake kwa ajili ya kusambazia maji ya umwagiliaji
shambani;
„mfumo wa umwagiliaji” maana yake ni majumuisho ya
maumbo na miundombinu mbalimbali
inayojumuisha banio, njia za kusafirisha na
kusambaza maji kwenda mashambani, mitambo na
vifaa ambavyo vinawezesha uwepo wa maji kwa
ajili ya kumwagilia eneo la shamba; „Mfuko” maana yake Mfuko wa kuendeleza umwagiliaji
ulionzishwa kwa mujibu wa kifungu 53; „mkulima mdogo” maana yake ni mkulima anayeshiriki
kwenye kilimo cha umwagiliaji katika eneo lisilozidi
hekta tano ambalo analilima mwenyewe au na
familia yake;
„mmiliki wa shamba au kitalu au jaruba” maana yake ni
mtu yeyote anayemiliki kihalali ardhi katika eneo la
umwagiliaji katika skimu yeyote ya umwagiliaji na
ambaye amesajiliwa katika kumbukumbu za Tume
na inajumuisha wakodishaji wa mashamba na
wanaolima au mtu yeyote anayemiliki na kulitumia
eneo linaloweza kumwagiliwa; „mmwagiliaji” maana yake ni mtu binafsi, kampuni au
kikundi kinachofanya shughuli ya umwagiliaji katika
skimu;
„msimu wa umwagiliaji” maana yake ni kipindi au muda
unaopangwa na Kamati ya Wamwagiliaji ya
Usimamizi wa skimu kwa ajili ya kuhakikisha kuwa
maji ya umwagiliaji yanakuwepo katika eneo la
umwagiliaji;
„mradi wa umwagiliaji” maana yake ni shughuli ya ujenzi
wa miundombinu ya umwagiliaji mipya au
kukarabati iliyoharibika au kuchakaa kwa lengo la
kuendeleza kilimo cha umwagiliaji inayofanyika
katika muda maalum.
„mkondo wa maji” maana yake ni mto, kijito,
chemchem, mtaro, ziwa na inajumuisha tawi la mto
wowote, kijito, chemchem au mtaro; „mtaro” maana yake ni njia au mfereji wa aina yeyote
ikijumuisha mifereji ya wazi iliyochimbwa na
mabomba kwa ajili ya kupitishia maji; „mfereji” maana yake ni mfereji au mtaro wa wazi kwa
ajili ya kupitishia au kusafirishia maji; „mifereji ya shambani” maana yake ni mfumo wa
mifereji ya umwagiliaji kwa ajili ya kusafirisha maji
kutoka mifereji midogo kuingiza shambani; „miundombinu ya umwagiliaji midogo” inajumuisha ujenzi
wa muundombinu ya umwagiliaji kwa ajili ya
kuwezesha kilimo cha umwagiliaji au kwa ajili ya
matupio ya maji au kulinda eneo la umwagiliaji
lisilozidi hekta kumi na tano lakini halitajumuisha
miundombinu ya umwagiliaji inayotumia pampu
kuvuta maji;
„mtumiaji wa maji” inajumuisha mtu au chombo
kilichoanzishwa kisheria na kinachotumia maji kwa
madhumuni yeyote kutoka katika mfumo wa
umwagiliaji;
Sura 331 „Rasilimali maji” ina maana kama ilivyotafsiriwa kwa
mujibu wa Sheria ya Usimamizi wa Rasilimali ya Maji;
„skimu ya umwagiliaji” maana yake ni eneo ambalo
linastawishwa mazao kwa aina yeyote ya
umwagiliaji uwe wa matone au kunyunyizia au wa
wazi ikiwa ni pamoja na mifumo inayotumia maji
yanayotiririka kwa nguvu ya mvutano wa ardhi au
kusukumwa kwa pampu kuingia kwenye mifereji au
mabomba kutoka kwenye chanzo wazi au chini ya
ardhi, au maji ya mvua yaliyokingwa;
‘‘Skimu ndogo ya umwagiliaji” ni skimu za umwagiliaji
zenye eneo lisilozidi hekta mia tano;
„skimu ya uwagiliaji ya kati” maana yake ni skimu ya
umwagiliaji kwenye eneo la hekta mia tano hadi
elfu mbili;
„skimu kubwa za umwagiliaji” maana yake ni skimu za
umwagiliaji zenye eneo la umwagiliaji lenye ukubwa
wa zaidi ya hekta elfu mbili;
„Tume” maana yake ni Tume ya Taifa ya Umwagiliaji
iliyoanzishwa kwa mujibu wa kifungu cha 3;
„ufanisi wa umwagiliaji” ni uwiano kati ya kiasi halisi cha
maji kinachotumika katika kustawisha mazao
shambani na kiasi halisi cha maji kilichochepushwa
kutoka kwenye chanzo kwa lengo la kustawisha
mazao;
„umwagiliaji” maana yake ni-
(i) matumizi ya kiasi cha maji katika eneo
maalum ili kukidhi mahitaji ya kuota na
ustawi wa mimea katika eneo husika kwa
kiwango kinachostahili kulingana na hatua
ambayo mmea umefikia katika ukuaji wake;
(ii) matumizi ya maji kwa lengo la kufanya
udongo uwe na unyevunyevu unaohitajika
kabla ya kupanda mazao; „umwagiliaji wa kutumia nyenzo ya kusukuma maji”
maana yake ni umwagiliaji unaohusisha kusukuma
maji ya umwagiliaji kwa kutumia nyenzo kama
pampu au nyenzo nyingine yeyote; „usimamizi shirikishi wa rasilimali za maji” maana yake ni
utaratibu wa usimamizi wa rasilimali za maji na
matumizi yake kwa kuzingatia watumiaji mbalimbali
wa rasilimali hiyo waliopo juu au chini ya mkondo
wa mto ikijumuisha ikolojia ya mfumo wa maji
husika;
„usimamzi wa maji” maana yake ni shughuli za binadamu
zinazolenga kuongeza upatikanaji na matumizi ya
maji kwa ajili ya kilimo;
„wadau” maana yake ni mtu au taasisi
inayojishughulisha na sekta ya umwagiliaji
ikijumuisha Serikali kuu, Mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa,
Tume, wabia wa maendeleo, vyama vya ushirika,
wauzaji wa vifaa vinavyotumika kwa umwagiliaji,
wasambazaji wa pembejeo, watafiti, wageni na
watu wote wenye maslahi katika maendeleo ya
kilimo cha umwagiliaji;
„Waziri” maana yake ni Waziri mwenye dhamana ya
umwagiliaji.
